name: Golf Scorecard
description: Score a 9 or 18-hole round for up to four players, set each hole's par, and see birdies and bogeys on the card.
prompt: A golf scorecard for up to four players: 9 or 18 holes, par 3, 4 or 5 for each hole, plus and minus buttons for strokes, totals and score to par, and a full card with Out, In and Total where birdies, eagles and bogeys are coloured.
author: gonzaroman
